subject: Procurement launch: aligning demo window & onboarding sprint
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Huang <jessica.huang@mapleinc.com>, procurement@mapleinc.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement launch: aligning demo window & onboarding sprint

Hi Jessica / Maple procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. To keep momentum and make sure the right stakeholders are present, I want to lock in a 60–75 minute session that combines: a short AE demo (20 min), an SE security/architecture deep-dive (30–40 min), and a quick procurement checklist review (10–15 min). My suggested windows next week (PST):

- Tue 2026-10-06 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2026-10-07 14:00–15:15
- Thu 2026-10-08 09:00–10:15

If those don't work we can also do afternoon CEST-friendly options; please advise availability and which folks will join (security engineer, procurement lead, legal if handy). I attached a short procurement onboarding checklist and our standard demo deck so your team can pre-scan.

Agenda (draft):
- 0–20m AE demo: inference flow, SLAs, pricing model
- 20–60m SE deep dive: VPC/private deployment options, data retention, audit logs, and integration pre-reqs
- 60–75m Procurement & next steps: timeline, PO/contract cadence, DocuSign pre-reads

Next steps: pick a slot, tell us attendees, and we'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: procurement_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pptx
From: Jessica Huang <jessica.huang@mapleinc.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@mapleinc.com>, procurement@mapleinc.com
Date: 2026-10-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement launch: aligning demo window & onboarding sprint

Hi Olga — thanks for the clear agenda. Quick constraints from our side:

- Procurement can do Tue 10/06 but only 09:30–11:00 (PST) due to an internal review.
- Security (Alex) is only available on Thu 10/08 between 08:30–11:00 PST for hands-on technical dives.
- Legal might not join initial call; they'd prefer redlines after the contract draft (we can loop them in after PO).

Would it be possible to break this into two sessions: a procurement-focused session (30–40m) with AE + procurement on Tue 10/06 at 09:30, and a separate SE security deep-dive (45–60m) on Thu 10/08 at 09:00 with Alex? If that's an extra coordination cost on your side, we can consolidate but security wants lab access details (SSH/ports) ahead of the meeting.

Also — can you confirm whether the demo environment will include a private VPC demo, or is it hosted staging? We need that to scope the integration review.

Best,
Jessica Huang
Procurement Manager | Maple Inc.
jessica.huang@mapleinc.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Huang <jessica.huang@mapleinc.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@mapleinc.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement launch: aligning demo window & onboarding sprint

Thanks Jessica — happy to split into two focused sessions, that actually helps ensure the right level of detail for each stakeholder. Quick technical clarifications: 

- For the SE deep-dive we can run a VPC-based private deployment demo (no shared data plane). If you want a hands-on lab, we'll need a temporary IP allowlist and one administrative user on your side for the test window.
- Typical artifacts we'll bring: security_integration_notes.pdf, our audit logs sample, and a short runbook for KV cache warm-up.
- For Thu 10/08 09:00 PST I can lead the SE session. I can also prepare a 15-minute pre-read with environment checklist if Alex wants to review before the call.

If procurement confirms Tue 10/06 09:30–10:10 we can treat that as a sprint 0 planning call focused on PO cadence and milestone acceptance criteria.

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Huang <jessica.huang@mapleinc.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@mapleinc.com>, procurement@mapleinc.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: procurement sprint 0 + security deep-dive (calendar invites sent)

Jessica — thanks, that plan works for us. I've split the sessions and sent invites for both windows below:

1) Procurement sprint 0 (AE + procurement): Tue 2026-10-06 09:30–10:10 PST
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456
- Objective: PO cadence, acceptance criteria, contract timeline, kickoff owner
- Attachments: procurement_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pptx

2) SE security deep-dive (SE + customer security): Thu 2026-10-08 09:00–10:00 PST
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=def789ghi012
- Objective: VPC demo, IP allowlist, test user setup, audit logs and retention discussion
- Pre-req: Alex — if you can share an admin contact and ephemeral IP range to allow, Marcus will provision the test window.
- Attachments: security_integration_notes.pdf

I've also included a short DocuSign link with our standard SOW/PO flow so your procurement team can accelerate internal approvals (link below). If you'd like us to route the SOW via your procurement mailbox procurement@mapleinc.com let me know.

Links: https://www.docusign.com/links/prep-maple-redwood-001

Thanks — invites are out; please accept so we can lock rooms. I'll follow up with the SE pre-read and a brief recording of the AE demo that Marcus will reference.

Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jessica Huang <jessica.huang@mapleinc.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@mapleinc.com>, procurement@mapleinc.com
Date: 2026-10-06T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed: procurement sprint 0 + security deep-dive (calendar invites sent)

Thanks — invite for Tue 09:30 accepted. Alex is copied and will follow up on the allowlist details tomorrow. Procurement will review the DocuSign link and route to finance; if we need any custom billing terms we'll flag them in the SOW. Looking forward to the sprint 0.

Best,
Jessica
Procurement Manager | Maple Inc.
